description: Change the courtroom of SELECTED days of a multiday CROWN or MAGISTRATES hearing. A day's duration is capped at 420, the length of a MAGISTRATES all-day session; the target session's real capacity is checked by courtscheduler. Contains only the changed days; unsubmitted days are never touched. Each day carries an optional 'virtual' flag: virtual=true means the day is (re)booked via its courtScheduleId and converted to a hearing day; virtual=false/absent means the day is persisted as a real nonDefaultDay - and when it carries a courtScheduleId that differs from the hearing day's current schedule on that date it is ALSO (re)booked in courtscheduler, releasing the old session's duration and deducting the new session's (SPRDT-1225). courtScheduleId is OPTIONAL on a real day - the UI has none to send when no bookable slot exists for the room/date (e.g. the day's own session is fully consumed); such a day is persisted as-is and never booked. A virtual day without a courtScheduleId is a 422 (booking is its whole purpose). The legacy integer 'courtRoomId' is accepted but ignored (room identity is 'roomId'). Schema violations are 400; all business failures (unknown hearing, unsupported jurisdiction, non-multiday, duplicate dates, courtscheduler rejection) are 422.
